description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5306010519622 BOLT,INTERNAL WRENCH: Line 0001 Qty 3865 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0085 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
